description: This file defines the SalesOrderPDFHeaderViewer class which extends Vtiger_PDF_InventoryHeaderViewer and is responsible for rendering the header section of a sales order PDF in the vtiger CRM system. The class's display() method creates a complex PDF header layout using various model data, including images, text, and formatted cells.

classes.name: SalesOrderPDFHeaderViewer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the header of sales order PDFs, inheriting from Vtiger_PDF_InventoryHeaderViewer.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the PDF header layout with logo, summaries, and various information sections, using model data and PDF rendering functions.
